result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of this has been checked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`. On success it refreshes the comments list.
- **Success message:** The hook shows a "Comment Updated" notification, not the component. This follows `features/CLAUDE.md`, which says success notifications go in the `api/` mutation hook.
- **Edit button:** `components/update-comment.tsx` adds an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer. The drawer has a body textarea pre-filled with the current text.
- **Comments list:** `comments-list.tsx` shows the Edit button only when `comment.author.id` matches the current user. Admins still get Delete on every comment, but not Edit.
- **Mock handler:** I added a `PATCH` handler in `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts`, since the app runs against MSW. It only updates a comment if the caller is its author.
